text: City X water is radioactive after tank explosion
short_label: False — City X water is safe.
plain_explanation: Tests from the city lab show no radiation in the water. The explosion was at a chemical plant, not a nuclear facility.
technical_note: Lab used gamma-spectrometry with detection limit <0.01 Bq/L. All samples below threshold.

supporting_evidence.excerpt: All water samples tested negative for radiation

text: Vaccine causes severe side effects in 80% of patients
short_label: False — Clinical data shows <1% severe reactions.
plain_explanation: Extensive clinical trials involving 40,000 participants showed severe side effects in less than 1% of cases. The 80% figure has no scientific basis.
technical_note: Phase III trials (n=40,127) reported severe adverse events in 0.7% of vaccine group vs 0.6% in placebo (p=0.32).

supporting_evidence.excerpt: Severe adverse events: 0.7% in vaccine group

refuting_evidence.excerpt: Claims 80% severe side effects without evidence

text: Government announces 3-day nationwide lockdown starting tomorrow
short_label: Unverified — No official government announcement found.
plain_explanation: No official government channels have announced a lockdown. The claim appears to originate from unverified WhatsApp forwards.
technical_note: Cross-referenced with official gov portals, PMO Twitter, and verified news agencies. No corroborating evidence found.

refuting_evidence.excerpt: No lockdown announcements in official channels

text: Flood in Region Y kills 200 people, thousands homeless
short_label: Partially True — Confirmed flooding, but casualty numbers unverified.
plain_explanation: Flooding has been confirmed in Region Y with significant displacement. However, the death toll of 200 is not verified by official sources, which report 12 confirmed deaths.
technical_note: Official disaster management reports confirm flooding and 3,000+ displaced. Death toll: 12 confirmed, 28 missing. The 200 figure appears to be speculation.

supporting_evidence.excerpt: Confirmed flooding with 12 deaths and 28 missing

text: AI will replace 90% of jobs by next year
short_label: False — No credible economic forecasts support this timeline.
plain_explanation: While AI is transforming the job market, credible economic research suggests gradual change over decades, not 90% replacement in one year.
technical_note: IMF, World Bank, and OECD projections estimate 10-15% job displacement over 10-15 years, with simultaneous job creation in new sectors.

supporting_evidence.excerpt: Gradual job transformation expected over 10-15 years

text: Election results were manipulated using software hack
short_label: False — No evidence of electronic manipulation found.
plain_explanation: Independent audits and paper trail verification confirmed election results. No evidence of software manipulation was found by election commission or independent observers.
technical_note: Electronic voting machines use non-networked systems with paper trails. Post-election audits (15% sample) matched electronic and paper counts with 99.8% accuracy.

text: New energy drink contains banned substances causing hospitalizations
short_label: Under Investigation — Food safety authority investigating claims.
plain_explanation: Food safety authorities are investigating reports of adverse reactions. Lab testing is underway, but no banned substances have been confirmed yet.
technical_note: 3 hospitalization cases reported. Preliminary toxicology pending. Product not yet recalled pending lab results (ETA: 48 hours).

text: Meteor strike imminent in coastal cities, evacuate immediately
short_label: False — No meteor threat detected by any space agency.
plain_explanation: All major space agencies confirm no meteor or asteroid poses any threat to Earth. This is a baseless panic-inducing hoax.
technical_note: Near-Earth Object tracking systems (NASA, ESA, ISRO) show no objects on collision course. Next closest approach: 2.4M km in 3 months.

supporting_evidence.excerpt: No near-Earth objects pose threat in next 12 months
All tracked objects outside threat radius

refuting_evidence.excerpt: Panic-inducing message with no scientific basis
